title: 52 Lurgan Park, Renmore, Galway, H91D9YV
description:
O’Donnellan & Joyce are delighted to present to the market this rare and impressive 5 bedroom semi-detached home, complete with a separate, self-contained 1 bed apartment, ideally located in Lurgan Park, Renmore, Galway.

Presented in immaculate condition throughout, No. 52 offers spacious and versatile accommodation, making it an ideal family home. 

The property also provides excellent flexibility for those working from home, accommodating extended family or guests, or buyers seeking an additional source of rental income.

On entering the main residence, the welcoming hallway leads to a bright and comfortable living room positioned to the front of the property. This inviting space features timber flooring and a feature fireplace, creating a warm and homely atmosphere.

To the rear, the kitchen/dining room overlooks the private patio and garden and provides a practical space.   

The house was recently upgraded with a brand new boiler for the central heating system. The boiler is housed externally along with a separate block built garden storage shed.  There is ample parking for 2 cars on the driveway.

Upstairs, the property boasts 5 well-proportioned bedrooms, with the master bedroom ensuite. A family bathroom and a separate shower room ensure excellent convenience for a busy household. 

A particularly attractive feature of this property is the separate self-contained 1 bed apartment, accessed independently via the front porch. 

The apartment comprises a comfortable open-plan living room/kitchen/dining area, with the bedroom and shower room at the rear. This versatile extra accommodation has energy efficient electric heating and is ideal for guests, family members, a home office or potential rental income.  

Renmore is a mature and highly regarded residential area, offering excellent schools, recreational facilities, shops and public transport.  Nearby primary schools include Scoil Chaitríona and Gaelscoil Dara, while Atlantic Technological University (ATU) is located on the Old Dublin Road.   

52 Lurgan Park is close to a range of healthcare facilities, including Bon Secours and Merlin Park hospitals and Galway Clinic.  Business Parks and centres of employment at Ballybrit Mervue and Parkmore are only a short drive away.  

Residents can enjoy a strong selection of sporting and leisure amenities, including the Kingfisher Club, St. James’ GAA and local community facilities, while Ballyloughane Beach and the surrounding green spaces provide excellent opportunities for walking and outdoor recreation. 

With Galway city centre easily accessible and regular public transport services operating nearby, Lurgan Park offers an excellent balance of convenience, connectivity and quality of life.

Whether seeking a substantial family home with extra accommodation or an investment opportunity with income potential, this property is sure to appeal to a wide range of purchasers.
